purpose: Teach: 歯ブラシ/酪農/石器/ニワトリ/和紙/魚介類/アヒル/下駄

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、歯ブラシ毎月替えてんだろ?
lines.en: Riku — you replace your toothbrush every month, don't you?
lines.style: Playful accusatory tone, leaning into a memory she's caught him in. Slight smile in her voice. Quick, testing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会で酪農の単元やったろ?桜
lines.en: You did that dairy farm unit in social studies, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Deflecting with his own gotcha. Casual, light turnabout. Not defensive — just matching her energy with a counter-question.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会で石器時代やったろ?
lines.en: Riku — didn't you study the Stone Age in social studies?
lines.style: Pressing harder, amused at him trying to dodge. Faster rhythm. Still testing him, but enjoying the game.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、田舎でニワトリ追いかけたろ?桜
lines.en: You chased chickens around in the countryside, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Dry delivery, barely suppressing a grin. Gotcha moment — he's found something genuinely embarrassing on her. Slower, satisfied beat.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、書道で和紙使ったろ?
lines.en: Riku — didn't you use washi paper in your calligraphy class?
lines.style: Quick volley back, not letting him win. Determined to keep matching him. Slight edge of mock-seriousness.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、給食の魚介類好きだろ?桜
lines.en: You like the seafood at school lunch, don't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Casual observation, slightly smug. Leaning in with the implication that this is something she tries to hide. Warm underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、池でアヒル見てたな
lines.en: Riku — I saw you watching the ducks at the pond.
lines.style: Triumphant, dryly amused. Slow burn on the memory. She's gotcha him doing something quiet and maybe a little soft. Barely contained laughter.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、夏祭りで下駄履いてたろ?桜
lines.en: You wore wooden sandals at the summer festival, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Close, conspiratorial whisper-near-laugh. He's delighted by this small memory. Warm and genuine — the gotcha has turned into something tender.
